revision: the commit that adds this file; the worktree is created from it before any mutant runs
workflow: Full test suite (python -m pytest -x -p no:cacheprovider --timeout=900 tests), Docker off (DOCKER_HOST at an absent pipe), PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, in a clean git worktree of the frozen revision. A baseline run with no edit must exit 0 first. killed = exit 1 (a test failed); survived = exit 0; timeout = 124. The likely killers are passed first only to save time; pytest de-duplicates, so the verdict is the full suite's.

not_applicable.split_leak: Cellarium builds no train/test split: its corpus is deposited whole, and the well4cell splits are built by that dataset's authors outside this repository. The operator has nothing to mutate here, and is recorded as not applicable rather than skipped.
